title: RESULTS: September 2026 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers
summary: PRESS RELEASE: 29,602 elementary teachers and 66,063 secondary teachers passed the September 2026 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers. Congratulations!

blocks.text: PRESS RELEASE: 29,602 elementary teachers and 66,063 secondary teachers passed the September 2026 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers. Congratulations!
The following is a press release from the Professional Regulation Commission.

The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) and the Board for Professional Teachers (BPT) announce that 29,602 elementary teachers out of 45,258 examinees (65.41%) and 66,063 secondary teachers out of 86,953 examinees (75.98%) successfully passed the Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers (L. E. P. T.) given last September 20, 2026 in 48 testing centers all over the Philippines, Hong Kong, Thailand and Vietnam. It is further announced that of the 29,602 elementary teacher passers, 24,816 are first timers and 4,786 are repeaters. For the secondary teachers, 59,121 passers are first timers and 6,942 are repeaters.
The Board for Professional Teachers is composed of Dr. Rosita L. Navarro, Chairperson; Dr. Paz I. Lucido, Vice Chairperson; and Dr. Paraluman R. Giron, Member.

The results of examination with respect to one hundred fifty-one (151) examinees were withheld pending final determination of their liabilities under the rules and regulations governing licensure examinations.
Registration for the issuance of Professional Identification Card (ID) and Certificate of Registration will be done on-line and will start on the following dates:

Please visit the official PRC website (www.prc.gov.ph) and follow the instructions for registration. Those who will register are required to bring the following: 1) Screenshot of system-generated Registration Form; 2) valid government-issued ID. Successful examinees should personally register and sign in the Roster of Registered Professionals.
The dates and venues for the oathtaking ceremonies of the new successful examinees in the said examination WILL BE ANNOUNCED LATER.
